notes_for_editor: Only three sources, and none gives a build date, builder, design, staffing or fire history. The FFLA Ohio list records Carbondale as a gone tower with no registry number. The OSU record ties a tower to the Carbondale Coal Company tract but gives no date, and it is not proven to be the same structure as the FFLA entry. The FFLA coordinates (39.34748, -82.27046) sit about 3 km south of the Wikipedia community point (39.37778, -82.27111), so the tower may not be in the village itself. Unverified lead: the same FFLA list has a gone tower named Waterloo at 39.31109, -82.28682 in Athens County (FFLOS US 1577), about 4 km away; nothing found links it to Carbondale. Nothing on the site today was found; a site visit, Zaleski State Forest or Ohio Division of Forestry records would be the next step.
